cohort: 147 pregnancies of 137 systemic lupus erythematosus patients, of whom 66 had lupus nephritis
finding: Systemic lupus erythematosus patients with proliferative nephritis (classes III/IV) had a higher frequency of adverse maternal outcomes.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was more frequent in patients with proliferative nephritis (classes III/IV) compared to those without nephritis.
